paragraphs.text: Drazhomir Yarnask is a soft-spoken second-year minotaur student at Quandrix College in Strixhaven University. Known for his gentle presence and deep love of poetry, he works quietly among the towering stacks of the Biblioplex , helping students locate texts and maintain the university's vast library collection.

Though standing over seven feet tall, Drazhomir moves with a stooped posture and quiet step, as if deliberately trying to diminish his imposing presence. His voice is so soft that many peers often ask him to repeat himself, despite the rich resonance that underlies his words. While many strength-based clubs and athletic organizations frequently attempt to recruit him, Drazhomir politely declines, preferring the tranquility of academic pursuits.

He works as a book clerk in the Biblioplex , where his sudden, silent appearances have startled more than a few distracted students. Outside of work, Drazhomir is a dedicated member of the Dead Languages Society. There, he immerses himself in ancient and nearly forgotten tongues, seeking out powerful poems buried in old tomes and reciting them aloud in soulful tones that reveal his heartfelt connection to the written word.

For those fortunate enough to be his friend, Drazhomir expresses affection through personalized poetry that never fails to brighten even the gloomiest days. But those who fall out of his favor may find themselves subtly ostracized within the Biblioplex, as fellow student clerks and even reference librarians begin to offer little more than cryptic guidance.
